title: MHDO Top 100 Most Costly and Most Prescribed Prescription Drugs
provenance: MHDO states that its analysis uses Wolters Kluwer Medi-Span MedFile v2, Canadian Drug File, and Maine APCD claims. This is a published derivative report, not a licensed raw Medi-Span extract.
periodNotes: Landing page Part I identifies November 1, 2022–October 31, 2023.
The same page methodology instead references April 1, 2022–March 31, 2023. Preserve this inconsistency; do not use the report as a day-specific classification snapshot.
The filename contains 231116. This is not treated as the effective date of each drug classification.
limitations: No raw MONY codes or classification change history.
Brand/generic labels come from MHDO report categories, not a separately supplied Medi-Span field.
No claim-level records, approved Tennessee drug lists, actual guarantee calculations, AWP history, or per-record effective dates.
Average WAC is not AWP and is not treated as a price for a specific claim date.
These records are isolated from Tennessee operational and audit records. No synthetic data added.
